verdict.rationale: Cerebras has a public pricing page with self-serve signup: $5 in free credits and self-serve payment starting at $10, so no sales contact is needed to start. However, none of the evidence shows actual per-token rates, let alone a rate for every hosted model. The docs pricing page as excerpted only mentions access through partner APIs. Missing for 10: published per-token input/output prices, coverage of every hosted model in a price table, and independent confirmation that prices are visible without contacting sales.
